name: FlavorVault
description: A polished mobile-first recipe manager with search, filtering, and favorites.
prompt: Build me a polished mobile-first recipe manager. Users should be able to add recipes with a name, ingredients, instructions, cooking time, and category, edit recipes, delete recipes, search recipes, and filter recipes by category. Allow users to mark recipes as favorites. Persist all recipes and favorites in localStorage. Use a dark modern interface with attractive recipe cards optimized for phone screens. Use only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.
